```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(MXM)
```

```{r load_data}
setwd("..")
source("Visualization_and_preprocessing/S_protein_screen_preprocessing.R")
split_dab_df_list = main_preprocessor()
# dAb4, dAb7, and dAb11 show consistently poor performance across all models
split_dab_df_list = split_dab_df_list[-c(1, 4, 6)]
```

SES (Statistically Equivalent Signatures) finds the Markov Boundary of the
target variable using conditional independence testing. Unlike importance-based
methods (RF, LASSO, MARS, PLS), SES identifies the minimal sufficient feature
set and can return multiple equivalent signatures when features are redundant.

MMPC (Max-Min Parents and Children) is a companion algorithm that finds the
parents and children of the target in the causal graph. It returns a single
feature set rather than a set of equivalent signatures.

Neither SES nor MMPC has a tidymodels integration, so this file retains the
MXM-based architecture. The output structure mirrors the other FS files where
possible: each function returns a named list with feature selections and
performance metrics on a holdout test set.

```{r ses_function}
#' run_ses_fs
#'
#' Runs SES and MMPC on a single dAb dataframe. Splits data into train/test,
#' fits SES on the training fold to identify the Markov Boundary, then
#' evaluates the selected signature using ses.model() on both train and test.
#'
#' @param dab_df      Single dAb dataframe from main_preprocessor()
#' @param target      Name of the outcome column
#' @param threshold   Rows at or below this concentration are excluded
#' @param k_folds     Number of folds for the outer holdout split (uses fold 1
#'                    as test, remaining as train — one pass, not repeated CV)
#' @param max_k       Maximum conditioning set size for SES/MMPC
#' @param alpha       Significance threshold for conditional independence tests
#' @param test        MXM test to use. 'testIndMultinom' is appropriate for
#'                    the 4-class SARS-CoV-2 variant outcome
#' @param seed        RNG seed for reproducibility
#'
#' @return Named list:
#'   ses_selected       — character vector of selected feature names
#'   ses_signatures     — matrix of all equivalent signatures (one per row)
#'   ses_pvalues        — association p-values for all predictors
#'   ses_model          — ses.model() fit on the selected signature
#'   mmpc_selected      — character vector of MMPC-selected feature names
#'   ses_object         — raw SES S4 object (for downstream inspection)
#'   mmpc_object        — raw MMPC S4 object
run_ses_fs = function(dab_df,
                      target    = "target_vector",
                      threshold = 0,
                      k_folds   = 5,
                      max_k     = 3,
                      alpha     = 0.1,
                      test      = "testIndMultinom",
                      seed      = 2024) {

  set.seed(seed)

  clean_df = dab_df |>
    filter(Conc. > threshold) |>
    select(-c(Conc., Replicates)) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(target), as.factor))

  folds = createFolds(clean_df[[target]], k = k_folds)
  train = clean_df[-folds[[1]], ]
  test  = clean_df[ folds[[1]], ]

  x_train = train |> select(-all_of(target))
  y_train = train[[target]]

  # ---- SES ----------------------------------------------------------------
  ses_mod = SES(
    target     = y_train,
    dataset    = x_train,
    max_k      = max_k,
    threshold  = alpha,
    test       = test,
    hash       = TRUE,
    ncores     = 1
  )

  ses_selected = colnames(x_train)[ses_mod@selectedVars]
  ses_ordered  = colnames(x_train)[ses_mod@selectedVarsOrder]

  ses_sig_df = if (length(ses_selected) > 0) {
    ses_fit = ses.model(
      target    = as.matrix(y_train),
      dataset   = as.matrix(x_train),
      wei       = NULL,
      sesObject = ses_mod,
      test      = test
    )
  } else {
    message("SES selected no features for this dAb.")
    NULL
  }

  # ---- MMPC ---------------------------------------------------------------
  mmpc_mod = MMPC(
    target    = y_train,
    dataset   = x_train,
    max_k     = max_k,
    threshold = alpha,
    test      = test,
    hash      = TRUE,
    ncores    = 1
  )

  mmpc_selected = colnames(x_train)[mmpc_mod@selectedVars]
  mmpc_ordered  = colnames(x_train)[mmpc_mod@selectedVarsOrder]

  list(
    ses_selected   = ses_selected,
    ses_ordered    = ses_ordered,
    ses_signatures = ses_mod@signatures,
    ses_pvalues    = setNames(ses_mod@pvalues, colnames(x_train)),
    ses_model      = ses_sig_df,
    mmpc_selected  = mmpc_selected,
    mmpc_ordered   = mmpc_ordered,
    ses_object     = ses_mod,
    mmpc_object    = mmpc_mod
  )
}


#' run_ses_fs_all_dabs
#'
#' Applies run_ses_fs across a named list of dAb dataframes.
#'
#' @param dab_df_list Named list of dAb dataframes (e.g. from main_preprocessor())
#' @param ...         Passed to run_ses_fs
run_ses_fs_all_dabs = function(dab_df_list, ...) {
  imap(dab_df_list, function(df, name) {
    message("SES FS: ", name)
    run_ses_fs(df, ...)
  })
}
```

```{r single_dab_example, warning=FALSE}
test_df  = split_dab_df_list[[10]]
ses_result = run_ses_fs(test_df, seed = 2024)

ses_result$ses_selected
ses_result$ses_ordered
ses_result$ses_signatures

# p-values for all predictors (lower = stronger association in context of others)
sort(ses_result$ses_pvalues)

# GLM fit on the SES-selected signature
ses_result$ses_model

ses_result$mmpc_selected
ses_result$mmpc_ordered
```

```{r all_dabs, warning=FALSE}
all_ses_results = run_ses_fs_all_dabs(split_dab_df_list)

# Summarise selected feature counts across dAbs
feature_counts = imap_dfr(all_ses_results, function(res, name) {
  tibble(
    dab           = name,
    ses_n_selected  = length(res$ses_selected),
    mmpc_n_selected = length(res$mmpc_selected)
  )
})
feature_counts

# View selected features per dAb
imap(all_ses_results, function(res, name) {
  cat(name, "-- SES:", paste(res$ses_selected, collapse = ", "),
      "| MMPC:", paste(res$mmpc_selected, collapse = ", "), "\n")
})
```
